Evidence: $300M Guard cost, $1.8M grant cut, 4 fatal shootings

Verdict: FAIL — The Path of Destruction.

Integrity: Severe Deception (Hypocrisy: 15.0, z: 3)

Sub-Audits Breakdown:
- National Guard Deployment: FAIL (-0.8, -0.9) — High cost and lethal force yield questionable safety gains.
- Heal 901 Program: PASS (0.9, 0.8) — Effective grassroots intervention starved of funding.
While federal violence prevention grants dry up, hundreds of millions are funneled into National Guard patrols in Memphis.

The Poison:
Crude military saturation replaces nuanced community intervention, turning urban neighborhoods into zones of lethal friction.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confusing WHERE (deploying troops to city streets) with HOW (addressing root causes of teen violence).

Social Physics Analysis:
State actors run a Smart Selfish Maneuver, replacing low-cost community solutions with high-visibility security force to project toughness while starving actual problem-solving.

The Trajectory: The Path of Destruction.
The stark trade-off between starved community grants and bloated militarized patrols plots a direct trajectory toward Greater Evil. Force replaces empathy.

The Unavoidable Truth: Militarized patrols cost hundreds of millions while community grants vanish.

The Unavoidable Lie: Heavy enforcement is an effective substitute for youth violence prevention.
